subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are synchronized and exact-head workflow checks pass, should these security-sensitive action updates land as one grouped batch?
rationale: The repair is mechanical, but the protected security label and breadth of credentialed and security-scanning workflows require explicit owner acceptance of the grouped executable-dependency update.

options.title: Approve repaired grouped batch
options.body: Land all verified pins together after focused guard tests and workflow syntax validation pass on the final head.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate CodeQL, app-token, Codex, or release/container actions into smaller owner-reviewed pull requests.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Keep the existing pins until the workflow owners choose a later update window.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired grouped batch
recommendation.body: Land all verified pins together after focused guard tests and workflow syntax validation pass on the final head.
